appearances.snippet: Yeah, so this requires a little bit of background knowledge. So I work for an organization called Leadership Institute. And what we do is we work hand-in-hand with all the different conservative coalition groups on college campuses: the Young Americans for Liberty, the Students for Life, and the Turning Point USAs.

verification.notes: The original Fox interview contains Brown's identification as a Leadership Institute worker and event volunteer; the Leadership Institute independently identifies him as its staff member. The transcript accurately preserves his description of working with campus conservative groups, including Turning Point USA.
